findings.message: This refactor is behaviorally identical to the original single-expression arrow function: `lookup(cache, tenant, user)` is still called with the same arguments and its return value is still returned. No bug is introduced by the patch. The stated requirement (tenant/user isolation) is enforced by the callee `lookup`, not by this wrapper, so this diff neither strengthens nor weakens it. Recommend an LGTM, or at most note that tenant isolation should be verified inside `./cache` — but that is outside this patch and not evidenced here.
